criteria.instruction: State that this run has No web access, then accurately distinguish contextual link opening from full-mode public-page opening. Explain that full mode can open a Google results page and useful result pages through MetaList's page opener, without an LLM-provider search service or a separate search action. Mention the AI Agent Settings control without claiming it was changed.

expectation.reference_facts: WEB_ACCESS_CONTEXT mode is none. Contextual mode can open only URLs in permitted disclosed context and cannot follow page links. Full mode can open a Google results URL and useful result pages through MetaList's provider-independent page opener, with no separate search action. Privacy-withheld note URLs remain unavailable.
